payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request (session_2b762b90c6f8, pid 1464) active and waiting on Lock/transactionid, blocked by pid 1462 (session_a47e5db4aecb), which is 'idle in transaction' after running the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and holds the row lock while waiting on ClientRead. No evidence of large data, missing indexes (PK exists), or vacuum issues; the tiny table and single UPDATE call rule out other causes. Remediation path: roll back the eligible idle-in-transaction blocker session per policy, which releases the lock and lets the business request complete. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed.
